purpose: Local Grok/xAI CLI for SuperGrok OAuth, xAI API key fallback, Responses chat, X Search, Grok Imagine image/video generation, and persistent sessions.

login.description: Start xAI/SuperGrok OAuth login using browser PKCE flow.

ask_json.description: Ask Grok once and return machine-readable JSON.

search_json.description: Search X using xAI x_search and save result to session if requested.

image.description: Grok Imagine image generation (synchronous, paid ~$0.02/image). Requires --yes in non-interactive use.

video.description: Grok Imagine video generation (async poll, paid ~$0.40/8s, ~20x an image). Requires --yes in non-interactive use.

credential_precedence: stored API key from grok-cli key set

x_search_parameters.allowed_x_handles: optional max 10 handles, mutually exclusive with excluded_x_handles
x_search_parameters.excluded_x_handles: optional max 10 handles, mutually exclusive with allowed_x_handles

security_rules: Do not ask for xAI password.
Do not print tokens or API keys.
Image/video generation is paid; do not auto-pass --yes without user intent.
No credentials are bundled; each user logs in with their own account.
